title: Openness of bounded local fibre dimension for algebraic spaces
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $f:X\to T$ a morphism from an algebraic space [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Point spaces have the atlas topology [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Assume $f$ is locally of finite type on etale scheme charts [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For $t\in T$ put $X_t=X\times_T\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$ [def-weil-residue-field, def-weil-affine-spectrum, lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. For $x\in|X|$, put $t=f(x)$. A chart at $x$ means a representable etale map $U\to X$ from an affine scheme and a point $u\in U$ mapping to $x$. Write $U_t=U\times_T\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$ and $\widetilde u\in U_t$ for the unique point mapping to $u$. Write $\dim_{\widetilde u}U_t$ for the minimum of the Krull dimensions of open neighbourhoods of $\widetilde u$ in $U_t$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Define $\delta_f(x)=\sup_{(U,u)}\dim_{\widetilde u}U_t$ over these charts. Then every chart at $x$ has $\dim_{\widetilde u}U_t=\delta_f(x)$, and $\delta_f(x)$ is a finite nonnegative integer. For every integer $d\geq0$, the subset $W_d=\{x\in|X|:\delta_f(x)\leq d\}$ is open in $|X|$. No quasi-compactness, properness, flatness, finite-presentation or Noetherian hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Choose an affine etale covering family $a_i:U_i\to X$ supplied by lem-a1-space-affine-etale-cover. Every $x\in|X|$ has a lift $u_i\in U_i$, so the family of charts occurring in the supremum defining $\delta_f(x)$ is nonempty. The same covering lemma says that every representable etale map from a scheme to $X$ is open on point spaces. The composites $U_i\to T$ are locally of finite type by the hypothesis on $f$.

Fix two charts $(U,u)$ and $(V,v)$ at $x$, and put $t=f(x)$. The fibre product $R=U\times_XV$ is a scheme, and lem-a1-space-fibre-product-point supplies $r\in R$ mapping to the specified $u$ and $v$. Its two projections are etale: they are base changes of the chart maps. Their base changes over $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$ give etale maps $R_t\to U_t$ and $R_t\to V_t$, by chartwise etale permanence. The distinguished point $\widetilde r\in R_t$ maps to $\widetilde u$ and $\widetilde v$: all three are the unique points over $r,u,v$ in these scheme fibres. Apply lem-sfb-etale-topological-dimension-at-point to both maps to obtain $\dim_{\widetilde u}U_t=\dim_{\widetilde r}R_t=\dim_{\widetilde v}V_t$. Thus all chart values agree. Since step 1 made the chart family nonempty, its supremum is this common value, proving every chart value equals $\delta_f(x)$.

source.place: Tags 04NL (lemma-dimension-at-point), 04N4 (lemma-dimension-at-point-local); chart interpretation in spaces-morphisms.tex Tag 04NM (definition-dimension-fibre), clause (3)

proof.text: For a chart $(U,u)$ the morphism $U\to T$ is locally of finite type, hence so is $U_t\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$ by lem-weil-pbc-lft-base-change. By the definition of locally finite type choose an affine open neighbourhood $H$ of $\widetilde u$ in $U_t$ whose coordinate ring is a finitely generated $\kappa(t)$-algebra; the single affine $H$ is of finite type over this field. By lem-kun-dimension-finite-type, $\dim H<\infty$. The minimum defining $\dim_{\widetilde u}U_t$ is at most $\dim H$, and it is nonnegative because every neighbourhood contains $\widetilde u$. Hence the common value from step 2 is a finite nonnegative integer.

Fix $d\geq0$. For each affine chart $a_i:U_i\to X$ of step 1, apply lem-weil-pbc-local-fibre-dimension-open to the locally finite type scheme morphism $U_i\to T$. It gives an open set $E_{i,d}=\{u\in U_i:\dim_{\widetilde u}(U_i)_{f(a_i(u))}\leq d\}$. Step 2 identifies it with $a_i^{-1}(W_d)$. Surjectivity of the covering family therefore gives $W_d=\bigcup_i a_i(E_{i,d})$: each image is contained in $W_d$, and every point of $W_d$ has a chart lift belonging to $E_{i,d}$. Each image is open by the openness assertion of lem-a1-space-affine-etale-cover, so their union is open. For empty $X$ the union and $W_d$ are both empty.

The item statement is unchanged from base and matches 04NT/04NM(3) restricted to a scheme target. There is no repair note and the base proof was empty, so the re-split rules do not apply. Step 1: lem-a1 gives a surjective affine étale atlas and open |t| for representable étale t; taking the affine components as charts is an elementary one-line fact. Step 2: R=U×_XV is a scheme by fibre-products-etale-covers; fibre-product-point gives r over the given u and v; R_t→U_t is the base change of an étale map; def-pc-scheme-fibre makes the lifts unique; applying 04N4 to both maps gives chart independence; the supremum equals the common value because the chart set is nonempty. Step 3: lft base change to κ(t), one finite-type affine H containing ũ, and lem-kun-dimension-finite-type give a finite, nonnegative local dimension (pointwise only). Step 4: this is the 04NT proof, with scheme openness from lem-weil-pbc-local-fibre-dimension-open and W_d = ∪a_i(E_{i,d}) open because |a_i| is an open map. The new node lem-sfb-etale-topological-dimension-at-point is exactly 04N4. It is self-contained, statement-only, and has real search records. I tested it on an open immersion, the generic point of A^1, a finite separable field extension and an empty source. It is not a duplicate: lem-trf-etale-cover-field-curve-nodality is only a special case (algebraically closed, Noetherian), the local-ring lemma is a different invariant, and nothing matches in the DAG or the main-20261015 blueprint. It does not restate a clause of the item. The declared tool_uses are all generic and accepted. Batch-5: lem-a1-space-affine-etale-cover and lem-a1-space-fibre-product-point reach sec-trace-formula only through the definition def-trf-algebraic-space. lem-trf-space-chartwise-etale-permanence is a foundational étale-permanence lemma for algebraic spaces that neither the trace formula nor Poincaré duality gives, and it is not a step of their proofs. All three are accepted. No SGA is cited.

lean.statement: theorem localFibreDimension_chart_finite_isOpen {T : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace T) (hft : ∀ (U : Over T) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.obj.obj), IsEtale a → LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom) : (∀ (x : Point X.obj.obj) (U : Over T) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.obj.obj), IsAffine U.left → IsEtale a → ∀ v : U.left, schemePointMap a v = x → topologicalKrullDimAt (U.hom.asFiber v) = localFibreDimension X x) ∧ (∀ x : Point X.obj.obj, ∃ d : ℕ, localFibreDimension X x = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) ∧ (∀ d : ℕ, IsOpen {x : Point X.obj.obj | localFibreDimension X x ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)})
lean.note: The structural map of X : AlgebraicSpace T is the morphism to the scheme target T; U.hom is its composite with a scheme chart. The helper localFibreDimension constructs the stated supremum with real data. No atlas or representative is chosen.
